evidence: Matches the Wallet label and modifies coin selection logic in src/wallet/spend.cpp.
rationale: Prevents a potential crash by guarding against a null pointer dereference in AvailableCoins TRUC filtering. Although dereferencing coinControl->m_version on unconfirmed mempool coins causes a null pointer crash, the author notes no current production caller triggers this: 'RPCs, the GUI and CreateTransaction always pass a coin control, and the tests and benchmarks that use the default only have confirmed coins.'
